analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined from 52.6 to 47.9, staying neutral. MACD histogram worsened from -0.0933 to -0.4645. While the 5-day low support at 117.89 holds, the inability to surpass the 5-day high of 127.28 and the failure to reclaim the 20-day high of 138.90 indicate weak upward momentum. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is prudent.
